lines.lyric_hangul: 내 손이 네게 닿을 때, 서로의 눈빛에
lines.lyric_translation: When I get my hands on you / When I set my eyes on you

lines.lyric_hangul: 처음 느껴본 감정에 숨이 차
lines.lyric_translation: I get breathless and I’ve never felt this way before

lines.lyric_hangul: 이건 설명이 안 돼, 절대 그저 그런 게
lines.lyric_translation: I can’t explain this / It feels so different

lines.lyric_hangul: 아닌 걸 알아 더 욕심나니까
lines.lyric_translation: So I want it more

lines.lyric: Geunyang nan ttereul sseugo shipeo cham eoieopge
lines.lyric_hangul: 그냥 난 떼를 쓰고 싶어 참 어이없게
lines.lyric_translation: I just want to whine

lines.lyric_hangul: 계산적인 생각들은 다 멈출래
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll stop being calculative

lines.lyric_hangul: 거짓말을 한 것처럼 들키고 싶어 이 설렘도
lines.lyric_translation: I want you to notice how I am feeling / As if you would notice that I was lying

lines.lyric: Geujeo ne gyeote hyanggicheoreom maemdolgi shireo
lines.lyric_hangul: 그저 네 곁에 향기처럼 맴돌기 싫어
lines.lyric_translation: I don’t want to just be around you like the scent

lines.lyric_hangul: I thought I knew, 다 아는 듯이 당당했지만
lines.lyric_translation: I thought I knew / I was so confident that I knew everything

lines.lyric_hangul: But I didn't know, with you, 다가갈수록 왜 더 어려워지는데
lines.lyric_translation: But I didn’t know, with you / As I get close to you, it gets more complicated

parts.lyric: But I didn’t know, with you

lines.lyric_hangul: 할 말을 준비해도 어딘가로 사라지고
lines.lyric_translation: Even when I have something to say, my head goes blank

lines.lyric_hangul: 결국 헛소리만 늘어놓죠 계속
lines.lyric_translation: At the end of the day, I’m saying just meaningless words

lines.lyric_hangul: 너의 그 손을 잡으면 자꾸만 내가 어리게만 보여
lines.lyric_translation: When I hold your hand / I feel like being a baby again

lines.lyric: Nal geureoke boji mallago nadabji anke eorigwangeul buryeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 날 그렇게 보지 말라고, 나답지 않게 어리광을 부려
lines.lyric_translation: And I go whining and saying, “Don’t look at me like that”

lines.lyric: Neowa du nuneul matchugoseo han georeum deo negero
lines.lyric_hangul: 너와 두 눈을 맞추고서 한 걸음 더 네게로
lines.lyric_translation: I look you in the eye and take one step closer to you

lines.lyric_hangul: 계획을 세워봐도 여전히 네 앞에 서면 나는 애야
lines.lyric_translation: No matter how much I plan and prepare / When I’m with you, I’m just a baby / Ey (I’m a)

parts.lyric: Yeojeonhi ne ape seomyeon naneun aeya

lines.lyric_hangul: Can I call you baby?
lines.lyric_translation: Can I call you baby? / Ey (I’m a)

lines.lyric_hangul: 사랑 앞에선, baby
lines.lyric_translation: In front of love, I’m just a baby

lines.lyric: Ara igeon ttesseundago dweneun geo anin geo
lines.lyric_hangul: 알아 이건 떼쓴다고 되는 거 아닌 거
lines.lyric_translation: I know I shouldn’t whine about it

lines.lyric: Jal ara igeon deo nae meorissok neoga daraneun geo
lines.lyric_hangul: 잘 알아 이건 더 내 머릿속 너가 다라는 거
lines.lyric_translation: I know it well that you’re everything in my mind

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 맘이 널 원해, 네 맘을 더 원해
lines.lyric_translation: My heart wants you / I want your love

lines.lyric_hangul: 이 맘은 꽤 독해, 너만이 해독제
lines.lyric_translation: This feeling is so toxic / You’re the only antidote

lines.lyric: Nae maeumeun hwakshilhande tto mamdaero andwenikka
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 마음은 확실한데 또 맘대로 안되니까
lines.lyric_translation: I’m sure about my feelings but I can’t control them

lines.lyric_hangul: 어리숙한 표현 행동 매너 보기엔 아직 애니까
lines.lyric_translation: The way I talk to you, treat you, and behave towards you / Is so immature

lines.lyric_hangul: 어른스러운 사람, 어른스러운 사랑, 어른스러운 남자
lines.lyric_translation: Mature person, Mature love

lines.lyric_hangul: 쉬울 것 같았던 것들, 네 앞에선 모든 게 어렵다
lines.lyric_translation: Mature man, I thought it would be easy / Everything is difficult in front of you

lines.lyric_translation: Am I under the illusion?

lines.lyric_hangul: 쉽게 끝이 날까? (Oh, na-na-na-na, what should I do?)
